name: TBS Factoring Service
summary: Fixed-rate factoring for owner-operators with credit protection and same-day processing.
differentiator: States no monthly minimums and no transfer fees and takes the loss when a customer cannot pay for credit reasons. Calls its rates "low, fixed" but does not publish them.

terms.recourse: TBS takes the loss if a customer does not pay for credit or funding reasons
terms.speed: Processed the same day you submit
terms.fuel: Fuel advances up to 50% on any load
